en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a rural residential street in Fagervik, Sundsvall, Sweden. The street is bordered by wooden houses with steep roofs and surrounded by trees, with several children walking barefoot along the road and people visible in the distance. The foreground features a wooden gate and fence. The back of the postcard contains address lines in Swedish and French, with a handwritten address to 'Fröken Lova Dahlin, Högom, Skön'.
